property_summary: For any valid inputs that do not cause a revert, C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for those same successful calls, so there exists inputs where the returned boolean differs.

For any non-empty equal-length tos and vs and a valid contract_address that responds to transferFrom calls (i.e., low-level calls succeed), C.transfer always returns true (call succeeds and yields true); the mutant inverts the returned boolean causing some successful calls to return false, violating that property.

For any non-empty equal-length tos and vs and a valid nonzero/non-self contract_address that successfully handles transferFrom calls, C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant flips the returned boolean causing some otherwise-successful calls to return false.

For any non-zero, non-self contract_address and non-empty equal-length tos and vs where each low-level transferFrom call succeeds, C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant flips the returned boolean so some successful calls return false.
